title: Fritz keeps his Turin hopes alive, beats Fils in Paris to set up Alcaraz quarter-final
snippet: Taylor Fritz, who needed the win far more than an already qualified Arthur Fils, beat the Frenchman 6-3, 6-4 to keep his Turin hopes alive and set up a quarter-final against Carlos Alcaraz.

title: BREAKING NEWS: Fritz earns 100th Masters 1000 win over Fils to set up Alcaraz clash in Paris
snippet: Taylor Fritz never faced a break point as the 11th seed beat sixth seed Arthur Fils 6-3, 6-4 on Thursday to reach the Rolex Paris quarter-finals, claiming his 100th Masters 1000 win. The victory keeps the American's Nitto ATP Finals hopes alive, but second seed Carlos Alcaraz awaits, and Fritz trails their head-to-head 1-5.
